title: Analyze data with Python

body.text: Upload a CSV / Excel / JSON file and
ask for analysis in plain language
— ChatGPT writes the pandas code itself: filter, group, pivot — without you needing to code.

example: "From this file, group sales by region, sort highest to lowest, and tell me which region grew fastest vs last year"

title: Techniques for good data answers

body.text: explore the data first (what columns, how many rows)
, then drill into questions — and always ask it to show the calculation steps so you can verify.

example: "First, summarize this file's structure: what columns, how many rows, any missing data, then propose 3 worthwhile questions to analyze"
